fit_policy: unchanged src.clean_atomic_probes.fit_converged_probe; raw float64 features; preprocessing none; all successor-admitted outer-train rows; fixed layer/C; one BLAS thread

bootstrap.method: topic-stratified endpoint multiplicities; pair m_i*m_j, atomic person multiplicity; shared historical/corrected draws
bootstrap.ci: 95% pointwise percentile linear; no redraw/imputation/topic-dropping; conditional on fitted heads

eligibility_policy.atomic_D: successor_status admitted, exact authoritative sidecar identity
eligibility_policy.facts: exact topic/entity/statement/truth and fact ID; admitted source affirmatives or exact accepted historical registry evidence retained as eligible by pinned candidate fact inventory; restricted source claims never overridden by registry evidence
eligibility_policy.compound_group: retain all 16 variants iff every exact constituent fact passes; same pair set for raw/or-both/minmax; preserve original identities and person keys
eligibility_policy.coverage_comparison: historical full old coverage versus historical retained; corrected versus historical on identical retained examples
eligibility_policy.evidence_limit: retained source-label-only evidence is allowed by accepted conservative correction; not independently audited truth

refresh.comparison: corrected_retained minus historical_retained; separately flag historical retained-minus-full coverage movement
refresh.rankings: all model rankings within each summary endpoint; all condition rankings for the same summary metric/model; AND-versus-OR ordering; chance-level side at AUROC 0.5
refresh.interpretation: also flag paired contrast CI sign category changes for AND-minus-OR and condition comparisons
refresh.action: identify downstream analyses; do not launch refresh
